text:
maria: Quick sync — SagePilot enterprise pilot. Need to lock integration gates + clear owners for the launch window the customer requested (target window 2026-05-18 -> 2026-05-25). TL;DR: SEs need webhook mapping + sample payloads, infra needs VPC peering + cert SANs, eng needs PR reviews. Who can own what?

alex: I can own webhook mapping + contract tests. ETA Wed 2026-05-10. Will open a PR and ping @jamie for review.

jamie: ack, I can review. Prefer small diffs. Also, what QPS should we size autoscaler for? Need numbers to set policies.

ryan: From infra: we need the customer's CIDR ranges for peering and approval for egress rules. Also need cert SAN for *.sagepilot-prod. ETA Mon 2026-05-08 after ticket creation.

sophie: From SEs/sales: success criteria the customer cares about — p90 latency <300ms for inference calls and error rate <1% during the pilot. They'll flag anything outside that.

kevin: QA: I'll own integration smoke and perf baseline. Can we agree a stable test model and a canonical test dataset?

maria: @kevin use model tag `v2.1-stable` — it's been validated by research. @ryan I'll loop in the customer to request CIDR ranges today.

deploy-bot: Deploy job #4521 queued for staging. Logs: https://deploys.redwood/4521 

alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/integrations/pull/884 — webhook schema + tests (draft). @jamie please review when you can.

jamie: Reviewing now. Left one nit about required/optional fields in the schema — will comment inline.

kevin: QA note: I need sample payloads for a few edge cases (long session_id, missing optional fields). @sophie can you paste a masked sample payload?

sophie: Sample (masked): ```json {"user_id":"<redacted>","input":"order + refund","session_id":"sess-1234"}``` -- I'll add a couple of variations to the drive.

maria: Owners recap: webhooks -> alex, infra peering -> ryan, certs -> jamie, QA/perf -> kevin, success criteria + SE point -> sophie. I'll update the milestone doc and add owners. If anyone can't meet their ETA, flag here early.

ryan: Peering ticket created (#7892). Waiting on customer CIDR and network contacts. Assigned to infra on-call.

alex: Wed ETA confirmed. I'll tag @maria when merged and add a small runbook for repro steps.

jamie: I can handle certs but need CSR details and SAN list. @maria can you share those?

maria: I'll share the CSR and required SANs by EOD today.

kevin: Scheduling perf window Thu 2026-05-11 10:00 PT. I'll run a short baseline + synthetic error injection. RSVP if you want to watch.

sophie: Sales will join the baseline call. Adding calendar invite and the customer success rep.

maria: Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll follow up with the milestone doc link and next steps. If blockers pop up, drop them here and I'll escalate.
